meta.title: About | Gama Institute
meta.description: The mission, vision and values of Gama Institute.

hero.h1: Research in service of trustworthy software
hero.lead: Gama Institute bridges software engineering and artificial intelligence to build safe, responsible and modern systems, through research, training, innovation and community.

mission.lead: Advance the state of the art at the intersection of software engineering and AI, and turn that research into practices, tools and talent for industry and society.

vision.h2: A future where AI is safe by design
vision.lead: To be a recognized reference center where researchers, practitioners and learners co-design responsible, verifiable technology for the benefit of all.

items.title: Scientific rigour
items.body: Reproducible results, openly evaluated and peer-reviewed. Evidence before promise.

items.title: Responsibility
items.body: Fairness, transparency and safety are not optional: they are at the heart of every system we design.

items.title: Openness
items.body: Open code, shared data and collaboration across academia, industry and community.

items.title: Excellence in training
items.body: Training the next generation of engineers and researchers able to build reliable AI.

pillars.lead: Each pillar reinforces the others: research feeds training, training fuels innovation, and community connects it all.

items.title: Research
items.body: Advancing knowledge at the intersection of software engineering and AI.

items.title: Training
items.body: Learning paths from fundamentals to advanced expertise.

items.title: Innovation
items.body: Turning research into concrete tools, prototypes and practices.

items.title: Community
items.body: Bringing together researchers, practitioners and students around responsible AI.

history.h2: From an idea to a research institute
history.lead: Gama Institute was born from the conviction that software engineering and artificial intelligence must evolve together, with reliability as the first requirement.

items.title: First works
items.body: A group of researchers and engineers begins work on the reliability of AI systems.

items.title: Institute founded
items.body: Official creation of Gama Institute and definition of the five research areas.

items.title: Training launched
items.body: Launch of the first course catalogue and the first professional workshops.

items.title: WeekPaper & community
items.body: Start of the WeekPaper series and growth of an open community of practitioners.

items.title: Partnerships at scale
items.body: Academic, industry and government collaborations on responsible-AI projects.

cta.body: Research collaborations, open positions and volunteer opportunities: there's a place for you at Gama Institute.
